verdict.rationale: The axis applies: ROS 2 is a robotics middleware and SDK ecosystem, so supported tooling for vision-language-action or robotics foundation models is a fair question. The evidence pack has no first-party documentation or community report of such tooling. Python client libraries, topics/actions, shared vision_msgs and the bag API for recording training data are only building blocks a developer could use to build this, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can integrate vision-language-action or robotics foundation models into my robot's autonomy stack through supported tooling
